objectives: 介紹數位系統之基礎概念，利用各種實例，對相關主題作深入淺出之說明，期能使學生瞭解數位電路的基本組成元件、及數位電路設計的方法。
content:
1. Introduction to digital systems; binary numbers
2. Boolean algebra
3. K map
4. Combinational logic
5. Flip-flop
6. Synchronous sequential logic
7. Sequential logic examples
8. Combinational building blocks
9. Combinational examples
10. Sequential building blocks
11. Datapath sequential circuits
12. Timing constraints
13. Arithmetic circuits
14. Asynchronous sequential logic
books: (1) William J. Dally and R. Curtis Harting, “Digital Design: A Systems Approach, 2012, Cambridge University Press. (2) Morris Mano and Michael Ciletti, “Digital Design: With An Introduction to The Verilog HDL, VHDL, and System Verilog,“ 6th Edition, Pearson Education ISBN 978-1-292-23116-7 (3) Charles Roth and Larry Kinney, “Fundamentals of Logic Design,“ 7th Edition, Cengage Learning ISBN-13: 978-1133628477
